newsitem.title: USA: Food Extrusion names chief executive.
newsitem.headline: Food Extrusion names chief executive.

text.p: Food Extrusion Inc Tuesday said it appointed Allen Simon as chief executive officer on April 14.
Simon joins Food Extrusion from Shaklee U.S. Inc, a manufacturer and marketer of nutritional and personal care products, where he worked for 12 years.
Simon replaces Dan McPeak as chief executive. McPeak remains as chairman of the board and will concentrate on developing the business.

"Allen Simon is the quality executive we have been seeking to lead our company to rapid domestic and international expansion," McPeak said in a statement. "He is uniquely qualified to develop our growth strategy since he has done it before in a strikingly similar situation."
